item.title: Trump DOJ escalates legal fight over states granting college benefits to undocumented immigrants
item.description: The Justice Department reports Arizona State University provided in-state tuition to 432 undocumented immigrants in Fall 2025, resulting in $10.5 million in reduced costs.
